title: approval.requested@1
description: Notification that an approval was requested. go-hitl is the decision wire. Unknown fields are allowed.

hitl_ref.description: URN of the decision record in the system that holds it: go-hitl, or the producer's own approval store (e.g. msg://approval/cerberus/<broker id>). Not a go-hitl id unless go-hitl holds the decision.
